cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Efficiency Win
cards.instruction: Celebrate each inconvenience as proof that a faster, cheaper, or smarter routine can now be invented.

beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The lift's broken. We can cancel the gym and use the stairs.
